theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Customize the appearance for Godot Launcher

trayAvailability.warning: System tray support could not be confirmed for this session. Godot Launcher will remain visible or quit instead of hiding.
trayAvailability.closeFallback: Close to system tray will leave Godot Launcher visible.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Choose Godot Launcher behavior for projects.
projects.confirmRemove: Ask for confirmation when removing projects.

autoStart.title: Startup Preference
autoStart.description: Choose how Godot Launcher behaves when your computer starts.
autoStart.linuxWarning: Auto start currently is not supported on Linux

projectLaunch.title: Project Launch Action
projectLaunch.description: Choose how Godot Launcher behaves after launching a project.

projectsLocation.title: Project Location
projectsLocation.description: Select a location for new projects. Existing projects will not be affected.

editorsLocation.title: Editor Installs Location
editorsLocation.description: Choose a location for Editor installs. Existing installs will not be affected.

clearReleaseCache.title: Refresh Release Cache
clearReleaseCache.description: Delete cached Godot release metadata and fetch the latest builds from GitHub.
clearReleaseCache.cooldownNotice: Cache refreshing is temporarily disabled to avoid hitting GitHub rate limits.
clearReleaseCache.successMessage: Release lists were refreshed with the latest builds.
clearReleaseCache.errorMessage: Something went wrong while refreshing the release cache. Try again later.

language.label: Language
language.description: Select language for Godot Launcher (does not change Godot language)

codeEditors.overview: Manage code editor detection and choose which editor is preselected for new projects.

path.label: Executable path
path.help: Leave empty to use automatic detection. A custom path overrides the detected installation.

textEditor.title: External Text Editor
textEditor.help: These arguments are used when Godot opens files in this code editor.
textEditor.flagsHelp: Godot placeholders include {project}, {file}, {line}, and {col}. An empty value is a valid override.

errors.invalidPath: Select a valid code editor executable.
errors.dialog: Unable to open the file selector.
errors.save: Unable to save code editor settings.

disableConfirm.title: Disable {{editor}}?
disableConfirm.existingProjects: Existing projects will keep this editor selection and their current Godot editor settings. They may continue to use it while it remains installed.
disableConfirm.newProjects: The editor will be unavailable for new selections and automatic project detection.

tools.overview: Review command-line tools used by Godot Launcher and open a tool to manage its settings.

installation.title: Installation
installation.description: Godot Launcher detects and validates this installation. It does not install or update {{tool}}.

selection.title: Terminal application
selection.unavailable: No supported terminal is currently available.
selection.unavailableSelection: {{terminal}} is no longer available. Rescan or choose another terminal.

errors.invalidConfiguration: The saved terminal settings use an unsupported format. Reset them to use automatic terminal selection.

reset.title: Reset terminal settings?
reset.message: This removes saved terminal choices and custom terminal settings for all operating systems. Other tool settings will not change.

git.title: Git
git.description: Git is a distributed version control system for managing code changes and collaboration.

installation.title: Installation
installation.description: Godot Launcher validates this executable before every Git operation.

global.title: Global Git identity
global.description: This writes user.name and user.email to Git's machine-wide global configuration.
global.unavailable: Install or restore Git before editing the global identity.
global.nameHelp: The author name Git uses when a repository has no local override.
global.emailHelp: The author email Git uses when a repository has no local override.

preset.title: Project identity preset
preset.description: Save one identity for repositories created by Godot Launcher. It has no effect until you select or automatically apply it during project creation.
preset.nameHelp: The author name suggested for a new repository-local identity.
preset.emailHelp: The author email suggested for a new repository-local identity.
preset.automaticDescription: Write this preset as a repository-local identity before the initial commit.

errors.load: Unable to load Git identity settings.
errors.required: Enter both a name and email.
errors.saveGlobal: Unable to save the global Git identity. The displayed values were refreshed from Git.
errors.savePreset: Unable to save the project identity preset.

connections.title: Manage connections
connections.overview: Connect external services to use them in Godot Launcher.
connections.genericDescription: Connect this service to use it in Godot Launcher.

flow.reauthoriseDescription: Choose an account to reauthorise, then continue in your browser to restore its GitHub connection.
flow.importDescription: Connect GitHub to browse and import your repositories.
flow.missingAccount: Not seeing the account or organisation you need?
flow.title: Connect GitHub
flow.description: Connect GitHub to continue. Your current work will be kept.
flow.browserDescription: Continue in your browser to authorise access, then return here.
flow.waiting: Complete the connection in your browser, then return here.
flow.accessDescription: Manage repository access on GitHub or add another account, then refresh the repository list.

github.description: Connect GitHub to make your repositories available to Godot Launcher.
github.accessNote: You stay in control of which repositories the GitHub App can access.

connections.secureStorageUnavailable: Set up your system keyring or credential store before connecting GitHub.

actions.installAnother: Install on another account or organisation

errors.accountMismatch: GitHub returned a different account. Select the account you intended to manage and try again.
errors.timedOut: The connection request expired. Try again.
errors.installationRequired: The GitHub App installation could not be verified. Check its repository access and try again.
errors.generic: Unable to complete this action. Try again.

drawer.title: GitHub connections
drawer.description: Manage the GitHub connections available to Godot Launcher.
drawer.chooseConnectionDescription: Select one or more existing GitHub App installations, or install the App somewhere new.
drawer.finishSetupDescription: Complete the installation in your browser. You can return here while Godot Launcher keeps waiting.
drawer.noInstallations: This connection has no accessible App installations yet.

disconnectConfirm.title: Disconnect {{connection}}?
disconnectConfirm.description: This removes the connection from Godot Launcher. It does not uninstall the GitHub App or change any project remotes.
disconnectConfirm.finalDescription: This removes the connection from this device. It does not uninstall the GitHub App, change repository access, or change project remotes.
disconnectConfirm.revokeAllDevices: Also revoke this GitHub authorisation on all Godot Launcher devices.
disconnectConfirm.revokeDetail: Other Godot Launcher devices connected to this GitHub account will need to reconnect.
disconnectConfirm.localOnlyWarning: GitHub access remains active on other devices, and any copied tokens remain valid until they expire or are revoked.
disconnectConfirm.failureDetail: The connection could not be removed. Your local credential was kept. Try again.

credentialStorage.restartFailed: Your choice is saved. Quit Godot Launcher completely and reopen it to apply the saved choice.
credentialStorage.title: Credential storage
credentialStorage.description: Choose how Godot Launcher accesses secure credential storage on Linux. Secret Service requires a compatible keyring running in your desktop session.
credentialStorage.warning: Changing this choice may require reconnecting GitHub. Existing credentials will be kept.
credentialStorage.saveError: Could not save the choice. Your previous saved choice is unchanged. Try again.
credentialStorage.restart: Fully quit Godot Launcher, including its system tray process, and open it again to apply the saved choice.
credentialStorage.restartPending: The saved choice differs from the choice used at startup. A full restart is required.
credentialStorage.override: A launch flag controls credential storage for this session ({{backend}}). Remove the flag before restarting if you want to use the saved choice.
credentialStorage.unavailable: Secure storage is unavailable. Check that a compatible keyring service is running and accessible, then fully restart Godot Launcher.
credentialStorage.selectionFailed: Secret Service was requested but is not the active backend. Check that a compatible Secret Service keyring is running, then fully restart Godot Launcher.
credentialStorage.statusError: Could not read the current storage status.
credentialStorage.summary: Choose secure credential storage for Linux.
credentialStorage.confirmChange: Save {{choice}} as your credential storage choice?
credentialStorage.savedCurrent: The saved choice matches the choice used at startup. No restart is needed for this change.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: Configure how Godot Launcher checks for updates
updates.betaChannelDescription: Download prerelease builds from GitHub; these may be less stable than official releases.
updates.readyWithVersion: Version {{version}} is ready, restart Godot Launcher to install it. <Button>Restart now</Button>
updates.readyNoVersion: The update is ready, restart Godot Launcher to install it. <Button>Restart now</Button>
updates.manualWithVersion: Version {{version}} is available, but automatic installation is not supported on this rpm-ostree system. <Button>Open download page</Button>
updates.manualNoVersion: A new version is available, but automatic installation is not supported on this rpm-ostree system. <Button>Open download page</Button>

windowsSymlinks.title: Editor symlinks
windowsSymlinks.description: Choose whether project editors use optional symbolic links or stay with local copies.
windowsSymlinks.checkbox: Use symbolic links for Windows project editors. This stays off by default so you can opt in when you are ready for potential elevation prompts during editor updates.
windowsSymlinks.note: Changing this setting does not convert existing project links; it only affects how future editor refreshes behave.

enableDescription.line1: When enabled, Godot Launcher links each project to the installed editor instead of copying it.
enableDescription.line2: This keeps disk usage low, but Windows may request administrator approval when new symlinks are created.
enableDescription.line3: Existing projects keep their current local copies until their editor version is changed or reinstalled.

disableDescription.line1: Switch back to local copies to avoid elevation prompts. Godot Launcher will copy the editor files into each project instead.
disableDescription.line2: Existing symlinks remain in place until their editor version is changed or reinstalled.
